question: Give the roles of the following officers in the parliament. a) The speaker of parliament b) Sergeant at arms c) Clerk to parliament

question: How is a Bill different from an Act?
answer: A bill is a proposed law; an Act is a law passed and signed by the President.

source.quote: How is a Bill different from an Act?

question: When does a bill become a law?
answer: When it has been passed by Parliament and signed by the President.

question: State one role performed by the following people in the parliament of Uganda. (i) Speaker of parliament. (ii) Clerk (iii) Sergeant at arms
answer: Speaker presides over debate; Clerk keeps proceedings; Sergeant at Arms maintains security.
